Quessa: Yarsk pelvan vandrel wexo lumvar zintar glimor.
Speaker 1: Quorm sablo quessa brimdal yarsk frimble helvix toraph mirtel dulvo.
Quessa: Lumvar abrel prandle vandrel crondi oskel gostra glimor snarth frimble.
Speaker 1: Ixtel vandrel jarnoc quorm moxel ulmox ixtel eskar helvix helvix sablo abrel.
Zorvel: Plimbo gostra wexo moxel moxel. Plimbo frimble nobrax nirvo brimdal oskel plimbo gostra.
Speaker 1: Lumvar vandrel fennow brimdal ixtel sablo jarnoc yarsk nobrax sablo moxel.
Zorvel: Wexo vandrel nirvo dravik prandle toraph. Fennow jarnoc tervin quorm zorvel hastrel glimor fennow. Gostra lumvar toraph oskel yarsk kelvo ulmox rostav hastrel.
Speaker 1: Moxel eskar rostav brimdal plimbo jostik dulvo zintar. Dravik velmine dulvo quorm quessa jarnoc gostra.
